selected.title: GPT‑6.2 Astra in ChatGPT Work: Build an Excel Report You Can Check
selected.summary: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol reached preview in ChatGPT Work and Codex desktop on November 17. OpenAI shows professional workbook examples. A small CSV with known totals gives workers a concrete way to evaluate Astra before using it on a real report.
selected.availability: Preview in ChatGPT Work. Available on eligible Plus and Pro accounts. Managed workspace access depends on settings.
selected.practical_use: Draft a weekly orders workbook from an invented CSV with known totals.

source_review.excerpt: Its slides, spreadsheets, and documents read less like AI
source_review.decision: Read the November 17 announcement, workbook section and ChatGPT Work availability notes. Spreadsheet improvement is OpenAI's claim. The CSV exercise is illustrative.
